claude.reason: The base spanning early September through September 29 is visibly declining — price drifted from the ~299 peak down through the 264–275 range with wide, overlapping red and green bars showing no tightening, and the measured giveback of 0.46 confirms the consolidation surrendered nearly half the prior leg's gain. The burst bar itself is tiny (1.3% range, only 0.65% close-to-close gain) and fails range expansion badly (vs_prior_5=0.46, vs_prior_10=0.31), meaning there is no real expansion out of the base. Two hard FAIL checks — C and RE — together with a visibly loose, declining base make this a marginal setup at best.
claude.key_risk: The base gave back nearly half the prior leg and the burst bar shows no range expansion, so there is no evidence of genuine demand returning at this level.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of 269.03 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest above the open.
